1 class Battle
    2   #=============================================================================
    3   # End Of Round end weather check and weather effects
    4   #=============================================================================
    5   def pbEOREndWeather(priority)
    6     # NOTE: Primordial weather doesn't need to be checked here, because if it
    7     #       could wear off here, it will have worn off already.
    8     # Count down weather duration
    9     @field.weatherDuration -= 1 if @field.weatherDuration > 0
   10     # Weather wears off
   11     if @field.weatherDuration == 0
   12       case @field.weather
   13       when :Sun       then pbDisplay(_INTL("The sunlight faded."))
   14       when :Rain      then pbDisplay(_INTL("The rain stopped."))
   15       when :Sandstorm then pbDisplay(_INTL("The sandstorm subsided."))
   16       when :Hail      then pbDisplay(_INTL("The hail stopped."))
   17       when :ShadowSky then pbDisplay(_INTL("The shadow sky faded."))
   18       end
   19       @field.weather = :None
   20       # Check for form changes caused by the weather changing
   21       allBattlers.each { |battler| battler.pbCheckFormOnWeatherChange }
   22       # Start up the default weather
   23       pbStartWeather(nil, @field.defaultWeather) if @field.defaultWeather != :None
   24       return if @field.weather == :None
   25     end
   26     # Weather continues
   27     weather_data = GameData::BattleWeather.try_get(@field.weather)
   28     pbCommonAnimation(weather_data.animation) if weather_data
   29     case @field.weather
   30     when :Sun         then pbDisplay(_INTL("The sunlight is strong."))
   31     when :Rain        then pbDisplay(_INTL("Rain continues to fall."))
   32     when :Sandstorm   then pbDisplay(_INTL("The sandstorm is raging."))
   33     when :Hail        then pbDisplay(_INTL("The hail is crashing down."))
   34     when :HarshSun    then pbDisplay(_INTL("The sunlight is extremely harsh."))
   35     when :HeavyRain   then pbDisplay(_INTL("It is raining heavily."))
   36     when :StrongWinds then pbDisplay(_INTL("The wind is strong."))
   37     when :ShadowSky   then pbDisplay(_INTL("The shadow sky continues."))
   38     end
   39     # Effects due to weather
   40     priority.each do |battler|
   41       # Weather-related abilities
   42       if battler.abilityActive?
   43         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerEndOfRoundWeather(battler.ability, battler.effectiveWeather, battler, self)
   44         battler.pbFaint if battler.fainted?
   45       end
   46       # Weather damage
   47       pbEORWeatherDamage(battler)
   48     end
   49   end
   50 
   51   def pbEORWeatherDamage(battler)
   52     return if battler.fainted?
   53     amt = -1
   54     case battler.effectiveWeather
   55     when :Sandstorm
   56       return if !battler.takesSandstormDamage?
   57       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is buffeted by the sandstorm!", battler.pbThis))
   58       amt = battler.totalhp / 16
   59     when :Hail
   60       return if !battler.takesHailDamage?
   61       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is buffeted by the hail!", battler.pbThis))
   62       amt = battler.totalhp / 16
   63     when :ShadowSky
   64       return if !battler.takesShadowSkyDamage?
   65       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is hurt by the shadow sky!", battler.pbThis))
   66       amt = battler.totalhp / 16
   67     end
   68     return if amt < 0
   69     @scene.pbDamageAnimation(battler)
   70     battler.pbReduceHP(amt, false)
   71     battler.pbItemHPHealCheck
   72     battler.pbFaint if battler.fainted?
   73   end
